{{- /* Injected into family/base article bodies so /purchase/, /pricing/, /privacy/ keep the family chrome. */ -}} {{- $name := "" -}} {{- with .File -}}{{- $name = .BaseFileName -}}{{- end -}} {{- $c := mdfCommerce -}} {{- $attrs := mdfCommerceAttrs $name -}} {{- $isPurchase := eq $name "purchase" -}} {{- $isPricing := eq $name "pricing" -}} {{- $isPrivacy := eq $name "privacy" -}} {{- if and $isPurchase $attrs -}}
{{- else if and $isPricing $attrs -}}
{{- else if and $isPrivacy $c.enabled -}} {{- $stub := eq .Params.mdf_commerce_stub true -}} {{- $facts := ne .Params.mdf_privacy_facts false -}} {{- if $facts -}} {{- partial "commerce-privacy-facts.html" (dict "Page" . "full" $stub) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
